colaborar.wiHeading: Why join DominiosDeLujo as a writer?
colaborar.wiP1: What we're building is rare. We're not just producing content — we're shaping entire digital publications, each one built on real expertise, passion, and long‑term vision. Some writers here lead full verticals as editors and strategists, guiding the long‑term growth of the brands they manage. Others contribute as specialised writers, bringing depth, clarity, and authority to the topics they know best. Both roles matter — and both shape the quality of our ecosystem.
colaborar.wiP2: You won't be building alone. You'll be part of a team that actively supports one another, shares knowledge, and grows together. Behind you stands a full digital infrastructure — premium domains, tools, structure, and an ecosystem built to help every vertical scale with intention and clarity.
colaborar.wiP3: As the platform expands, we reinvest directly into the writers and publications that deliver results, providing support and resources far beyond what any individual creator could build alone. This is the strength of our ecosystem: a community of creators who think with intention, take pride in their craft, and grow with the platform as the platform grows with them. With the right structure and the right people, a small, focused group can build something far greater than the sum of its parts.
colaborar.wiP4: To protect the quality of what we build, we follow the editorial principles of the world's leading luxury publications: independence, accuracy, transparency, and a premium human voice. Every article is crafted with care, grounded in real expertise, and written with the long‑term reputation of the publication in mind. Affiliate links are used with clarity and integrity, never at the expense of trust. Our standards ensure that each site in the ecosystem feels like a true luxury magazine — elegant, authoritative, and built on editorial excellence — while giving every writer the freedom to express their perspective with honesty and depth.
colaborar.writersBody: Do you write about lifestyle, fashion, gastronomy, travel or luxury properties? We want your voice. We seek writers with a passion for the premium sector and the ability to create high-calibre editorial content.

colaborar.valuesBody: All collaborators work under the LujoTotal™ standard — the mark of excellence that unifies our premium editorial platform. Rigour, elegance, and authenticity are our core values.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Welcome to DominiosDeLujo.com ("Website", "Platform", "we", "us", or "our"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect personal information when you visit or interact with our Platform. By accessing the Website, you consent to the practices described in this Policy.
privacy.collectPersonal: Personal Data (voluntarily provided): name, email address, contact details, and information submitted through forms or partnership inquiries.
privacy.collectUsage: Usage Data (automatically collected): IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, time spent, referral sources, general geographic location, and cookie or analytics identifiers.
privacy.collectAggregated: Aggregated Insights: anonymized trends such as category interest, engagement metrics, and geographic patterns. Aggregated data cannot identify any individual.
privacy.useBody: We use collected data to operate, maintain, and improve the Platform; deliver curated luxury content and affiliate promotions; respond to inquiries or partnership requests; analyze usage patterns; generate anonymized analytics; and ensure security, fraud prevention, and compliance. We do not use personal data for automated decision-making or profiling.
privacy.sharingBody1: We may share aggregated, anonymized analytical insights derived from Platform usage, such as category-level interest trends, non-personal demographic patterns, and engagement metrics. These insights never include personal data and comply with applicable privacy laws including CCPA/CPRA.
privacy.sharingBody2: We may share aggregated, anonymized insights with analytics providers, affiliate networks, and service providers that support Platform operations. These insights do not contain personal data and cannot be used to identify any individual. Personal information is never shared with third parties unless required by law or explicitly authorized by the user. All third parties operate under strict confidentiality and data-protection agreements.
privacy.noSell: We do not sell personal information.
privacy.cookiesBody: The Platform uses cookies and similar technologies for essential functionality, analytics, and personalized content. You may manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Third-party tools such as Google Analytics may collect anonymized usage data.
privacy.rightsBody: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data; opt-out of data sharing for advertising or analytics; withdraw consent; or request a copy of your data.
privacy.californiaRights: California residents may exercise CCPA/CPRA rights, including the right to opt-out of data sharing ("Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information").
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise any rights, contact us at the email below.
privacy.retentionBody: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for Platform operations, legal obligations, security, and business continuity. Afterward, data is securely deleted or anonymized.
privacy.securityBody: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration. While no system is completely secure, we take privacy and data protection seriously.
privacy.internationalBody: Data may be processed in the United States. Where required, we implement appropriate safeguards for international data transfers consistent with applicable laws.
privacy.childrenBody: The Platform is not intended for individuals under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Updates will be posted with a revised effective date. Continued use of the Website constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or requests, contact: info@dominiosdelujo.com
